analysis.pricePattern: Higher Low 패턴 확인, 5일 저가 96,515원 > 20일 저가 82,710원
analysis.pricePatternEn: Higher Low pattern confirmed, 5-day low 96,515 > 20-day low 82,710
analysis.reason: RSI 43.1에서 50.7로 회복하며 과매도 구간 탈출 확인. MACD 히스토그램은 326.4744에서 1507.8579로 개선되며 상승 전환 신호 강화. 5일 저가가 20일 저가보다 높아 Higher Low 패턴 형성 시작. 3거래일 연속 관망 후 매수 진입 고려 구간.
analysis.reasonEn: RSI recovered from 43.1 to 50.7, confirming exit from oversold territory. MACD histogram improved from 326.4744 to 1507.8579, strengthening the bullish reversal signal. The 5-day low is higher than the 20-day low, initiating a Higher Low pattern. Considering a buy entry after 3 consecutive sessions of waiting.

analysis.narrativeEn:
[Trend Position]
· Current price (107,935 KRW) vs SMA5 (101,361 KRW) / SMA20 (102,306 KRW) / SMA50 (119,142 KRW) — below short-term and mid-term trends, below mid-term trend.
· Position relative to SMA100 (110,581 KRW) / SMA200 (88,915 KRW) — below mid-long term trend, above long-term trend.
· 52-week position (59.8%) + current price level at historical mid-range.
[Momentum Indicators]
· RSI trajectory (43.1→50.7) + exiting oversold, upward momentum.
· MACD histogram trajectory (326.4744→1507.8579) + improving, bullish reversal signal.
· Bollinger Band current price position (Mid Band 102,306 KRW) + 25.36% band width level.
[Support & Resistance Structure]
· Swing Support (82,710 KRW) + based on Pivot S1 (88,763 KRW).
· Swing Resistance (126,140 KRW) + breakout would strengthen uptrend.
· 5-day/20-day High/Low Pattern (Higher Low) + interpreted as recovery trend.
[Volume & Conclusion]
· Volume ratio (0.57x) + subdued confidence in movement.
· Current phase diagnosis (Accumulation) + buy entry conditions met.
